content:
35+ Gaming & Tech Brands That Sponsor Small Streamers (2026 List)

You don't need 10,000 viewers to land your first gaming sponsorship. Dozens of gaming, tech, and lifestyle brands are actively seeking small streamers with engaged audiences. The problem? Finding which brands actually accept smaller creators.

We've done the research. This comprehensive list includes 35+ brands with official creator programs, affiliate opportunities, and sponsorship applications—all accessible to streamers with under 1,000 concurrent viewers.

Skip the Applications—Get Direct Offers

Tired of filling out forms? On Newcollab, gaming and tech brands browse your content ideas and send you sponsorship offers directly. No cold emails. No waiting.

Let Brands Find You

📋Table of Contents

1. What Brands Look for in Small Streamers
2. Gaming Peripherals (Keyboards, Mice, Headsets)
3. Streaming Gear (Mics, Cameras, Lighting)
4. Energy Drinks & Snacks (Gamer Fuel)
5. Gaming Chairs & Desks
6. PC Components (GPUs, Cases, Cooling)
7. VPNs, Software & Tech Services
8. Indie Game Publishers Looking for Streamers
9. Tips for Landing Your First Gaming Sponsorship
10. Conclusion

What Brands Look for in Small Streamers

Before diving into the list, understand what makes small streamers attractive to sponsors:

  • High Engagement Rate: A 50-viewer stream where chat is active beats a 500-viewer stream with dead chat.
  • Consistent Schedule: Brands want reliable partners who stream regularly.
  • Niche Audience: 'Cozy gamers,' 'competitive FPS players,' or 'retro gaming enthusiasts' are more valuable than 'just a gamer.'
  • Content Quality: Clean audio, decent video, and professional overlays show you're serious.
  • Authentic Voice: Brands want genuine recommendations, not scripted reads.

Most brands on this list accept streamers with 50-500 average concurrent viewers (CCV). Some affiliate programs have no minimum requirements at all.

Gaming Peripherals (Keyboards, Mice, Headsets)

Peripheral brands are the most common sponsors for small streamers. They benefit from having their products visible on stream and in setup tours.

  1. Glorious Gaming: Known for their GMMK keyboards and Model O mice. Very small-streamer friendly. Affiliate program open to all creators, Apply Here.
  2. Keychron: Popular mechanical keyboard brand with strong affiliate program. Great for cozy/aesthetic streamers, Apply Here.
  3. HyperX: Known for sponsoring streamers of all sizes. Has both affiliate and ambassador programs. Check their website for current openings.
  4. SteelSeries: Offers affiliate program through Impact Radius. Quality peripherals, apply through affiliate networks.
  5. Razer: 'Razer Affiliate' program available for smaller creators. Apply via Razer Insider community.
  6. Logitech G: Ambassador program with periodic open applications. Check Logitech G website for application windows.
  7. Wooting: Enthusiast keyboard brand actively seeking authentic reviewers. Email their partnership team directly.
  8. Cooler Master: Affiliate program open to gaming creators. Apply through their website partnerships page.

"I started with Glorious's affiliate program at 40 CCV. After posting consistent content with their keyboard, they upgraded me to a sponsored creator with free products. Start small, prove your value."

- Tyler 'MechKeys' R., Variety Streamer

Streaming Gear (Mics, Cameras, Lighting)

Audio and video equipment brands love partnering with streamers who showcase their gear in action.

  1. FIFINE: Budget-friendly mic brand aggressively partnering with small creators. Very responsive to DMs, Apply Here.
  2. TONOR: Another budget mic brand with active creator program. Email partnerships@tonormic.com.
  3. Elgato: Premium streaming gear. Ambassador program exists but competitive. Apply through Corsair partnership portal.
  4. Audio-Technica: Quality mics with affiliate program. Apply through affiliate networks like ShareASale.
  5. Rode: Professional audio brand with content creator program. Check their website for partnership opportunities.
  6. Neewer: Lighting and camera gear at accessible prices. Very open to working with small creators, Apply Here.
  7. Govee: RGB lighting brand popular with streamers. Active affiliate and ambassador program, apply on their website.

Energy Drinks & Snacks (Gamer Fuel)

Gaming energy and snack brands are always looking for authentic streamer partnerships.

  1. G Fuel: The most streamer-friendly energy brand. Very accessible affiliate program. Low requirements, Apply Here.
  2. Sneak Energy: UK-based competitor actively expanding creator roster. Open to small streamers, Apply Here.
  3. Ghost Gamer: Premium gaming energy drink with creator program. Apply through their website.
  4. Rogue Energy: Affordable gaming supplement brand. Ambassador program open to creators with 1K+ social followers.
  5. Madrinas Coffee: Gaming-focused coffee brand. Known for supporting small streamers, check their website.
  6. CTRL Meal Replacement: Gaming nutrition brand. Affiliate program available, apply via their site.

Gaming Chairs & Desks

Furniture brands benefit from being visible in every stream. Many actively sponsor smaller creators.

  1. Secretlab: Premium gaming chairs. Ambassador program is competitive but accepts quality small streamers. Apply through their website.
  2. noblechairs: European gaming chair brand with creator program. Email their partnership team.
  3. AndaSeat: Actively partnering with streamers of all sizes. Very small-streamer friendly, check their website.
  4. Autonomous: Standing desks and ergonomic furniture. Affiliate and ambassador program available, Apply Here.
  5. Flexispot: Standing desk brand with active creator program. Open to content creators, apply on their website.
  6. GTRacing: Budget gaming chair brand eager to work with small streamers. Very accessible program, check their site.

PC Components (GPUs, Cases, Cooling)

PC component brands often sponsor build streams and tech review content.

  1. NZXT: PC cases and builds. Has content creator program. Apply through their website.
  2. be quiet!: German cooling and PSU brand with partnership program. Email partnerships team.
  3. Phanteks: PC cases with growing creator program. Check website for opportunities.
  4. Thermaltake: Cases, cooling, and peripherals. Ambassador program available.
  5. EKWB: Custom water cooling. Great for PC building streamers. Apply through their website.
  6. Lian Li: Premium PC cases. Partnership program for quality creators.

VPNs, Software & Tech Services

Software and service brands have high margins and can afford generous sponsorship deals.

  1. NordVPN: Most common streamer sponsor. Very accessible affiliate program. High commission rates, Apply Here.
  2. Surfshark: Competitive VPN actively seeking streamers. Good rates for small creators, apply on their site.
  3. ExpressVPN: Premium VPN with creator program. Affiliate program available.
  4. Streamlabs: Streaming software with partnership opportunities. Check their website for creator programs.
  5. StreamElements: Free streaming tools with ambassador program. Great for small streamers.
  6. Medal.tv: Clip capturing software actively partnering with creators. Very small-streamer friendly.

Indie Game Publishers Looking for Streamers

Indie game studios have smaller marketing budgets but are far more likely to work with small streamers. This is your secret weapon.

  1. Devolver Digital: Indie publisher known for working with smaller creators. Press/streamer keys available, email press@devolverdigital.com.
  2. Team17: Publisher of many indie hits. Press contact available on their website.
  3. Raw Fury: Indie publisher actively seeking diverse content creators. Very small-streamer friendly.
  4. Annapurna Interactive: Quality indie games, open to smaller creators. Check their press page.
  5. tinyBuild: Prolific indie publisher with creator-friendly policies. Email their press team.
  6. Coffee Stain Studios: Makers of Satisfactory and Valheim. Active with content creators.

Pro Tip: Indie devs often reach out to streamers who play their games organically. Start playing indie games you genuinely enjoy, and opportunities will come.

"I got my first paid sponsorship from an indie dev whose game I was already playing. They saw my stream, loved my community's reaction, and offered me $200 to play their new game on launch day. At 80 CCV."

- Amanda 'CozyPlays' K., Indie Game Streamer

Tips for Landing Your First Gaming Sponsorship

Having the list is step one. Here's how to actually convert applications into partnerships:

  • Start with Affiliate Programs: Most brands accept affiliates easily. Prove you can drive sales, then upgrade to sponsored partnerships.
  • Build a Sponsorship Deck: A 1-2 page PDF with your stats, audience demographics, and content examples. Check our Gaming Sponsorship Strategy Guide for templates.
  • Feature Products You Already Own: Already have a Glorious keyboard? Feature it on stream, tag them, then apply. Shows you're already a fan.
  • Apply to 10+ Brands: Not everyone will say yes. Cast a wide net across different categories.
  • Follow Up After 2 Weeks: A polite follow-up email can bump your application to the top.
  • Be Patient: Many programs have quarterly review cycles. Apply and keep streaming.

Affiliate1K+ social followersCommission (5-20%)High (70%+)
Product Gifting50-200 CCVFree productsMedium (40-60%)
Paid Sponsorship200+ CCV$50-$500+ per streamLower (20-40%)
Ambassador300+ CCV, brand alignmentProducts + monthly paymentCompetitive (15-25%)

Conclusion

Getting sponsored as a small streamer is absolutely achievable. This list of 35+ gaming and tech brands provides direct pathways to partnerships, from easy-to-join affiliate programs to more exclusive ambassador opportunities. Start with affiliates, build your track record, and work your way up.

Remember: engagement matters more than numbers. A brand would rather sponsor a 75 CCV streamer with an active, loyal community than a 500 CCV streamer with dead chat. Focus on building genuine connections with your audience, and sponsorships will follow.

faq.question: How many viewers do I need to get gaming sponsorships?
faq.answer: Most affiliate programs have no minimum requirements. For product gifting, 50-200 average concurrent viewers (CCV) is typically enough. Paid sponsorships usually start around 200+ CCV, but engagement rate matters more than raw numbers.

faq.question: Which gaming brands are most likely to sponsor small streamers?
faq.answer: Budget peripheral brands (Glorious, FIFINE, Keychron), energy drink brands (G Fuel, Sneak), and indie game publishers are the most accessible for small streamers. They actively seek authentic creators regardless of audience size.

faq.question: Should I start with affiliate programs or sponsorships?
faq.answer: Start with affiliate programs. They're easier to get accepted into, and proving you can drive sales makes upgrading to sponsored partnerships much easier. Most brands prefer creators who have already demonstrated value as affiliates.

faq.question: How do I apply to brands not on this list?
faq.answer: Check the brand's website footer for 'Affiliates,' 'Partners,' or 'Creators' links. If they don't have a public application, send a professional email to their marketing team with your sponsorship deck attached.

faq.question: What's the difference between affiliate, gifted, and paid sponsorships?
faq.answer: Affiliates earn commission on sales (5-20%). Gifted sponsorships provide free products in exchange for content. Paid sponsorships include a fee ($50-$500+ per stream) plus products. Most creators progress from affiliate to gifted to paid.

faq.question: How can Newcollab help me get gaming sponsorships?
faq.answer: Instead of applying to dozens of brands individually, Newcollab lets you post your stream or content ideas. Gaming and tech brands browse these ideas and send you direct sponsorship offers. It's a more efficient approach than cold applications.
